responsibility: This file implements C-side operand and pattern predicates that the NDS32 machine descriptions depend on but cannot express purely in predicates.md. It validates multiple load/store and stack push/pop PARALLEL forms, recognizes target-specific constant and memory properties such as bclr/bset/btgl/bitci legality, symbolic load/store and floating-memory restrictions, conditional-move edge cases, const_double/vector encodability, and related helper tests used by constraints and instruction patterns.
